purpose: Nonduplicate successor to the already-fused destructive whole-file rewrite negative result. Tighten the proposed PREIMAGE_BOUND_EDIT_PRESERVATION_CONTRACT into a deterministic patch-application acceptance shape without claiming runtime pass.

already_fused_current_evidence.incident: tools/grid10_fabric.py 672-line preimage -> 87-line fabricated whole-file rewrite; contained before origin push
already_fused_current_evidence.reason_for_extension: Current main already says prefer patch/diff and verify preimage/unchanged regions, but does not yet make patch target equality, deterministic applicability, full pre/post hashes, and post-apply collateral-change proof explicit in one acceptance contract.

patch_integrity_contract.name: EXACT_PREIMAGE_PATCH_INTEGRITY/v1
preconditions: bind exact repository commit and tree identity
for every existing target bind path, committed blob identity, byte length, and full pre-edit SHA-256
reject dirty or otherwise ambiguous target preimages unless the dirty bytes are themselves explicitly admitted and hash-bound
require declared target-file set == parsed patch target-file set
reject absolute paths, traversal, undeclared targets, duplicate target aliases, and ambiguous renames
applicability: represent ordinary existing-file modifications as unified diff or an equivalently bounded structured edit rather than unconstrained whole-file regeneration
run git apply --check or a deterministic equivalent against the same exact bound preimage before mutation
reject fuzzy, stale, offset-ambiguous, or otherwise non-exact application when exact identity cannot be preserved
a coarse shrink threshold is defense in depth only and can never substitute for patch integrity
post_apply_integrity: record full post-edit SHA-256 and byte length for every touched file
prove every file outside the declared target set is byte-identical to its pre-edit identity
for each touched existing file, prove bytes outside declared patch hunks are unchanged, or bind an equivalent deterministic structural preservation proof
make deletion intent explicit; unexpected file deletion or unexpected large-region deletion fails closed
require actual changed-file set == declared target-file set after apply
run requested positive tests and destructive/collateral negative regressions only after edit-integrity checks pass
rollback: on any integrity or semantic verification failure restore exact pre-edit bytes before commit authority
verify rollback hashes equal the bound pre-edit hashes
unknown rollback outcome blocks commit/push rather than triggering blind replay
patch_integrity_contract.whole_file_replacement_exception: Full replacement is a separate explicit operation class. It requires declared full-replacement intent plus bound pre/post identities and intended deletion scope; it must not be inferred from a normal modification request.
patch_integrity_contract.acceptance_rule: PATCH_APPLICABILITY_PASS + PREIMAGE_IDENTITY_PASS + TARGET_SET_PASS + COLLATERAL_PRESERVATION_PASS + POSTIMAGE_IDENTITY_PASS + ROLLBACK_CAPABLE + SEMANTIC_REGRESSIONS_PASS; otherwise FAIL_CLOSED

donor_reuse.reused_principle: exact commit/tree/blob source rehydration before patch synthesis and application checking

hypothesis.statement: Exact-preimage patch application plus target-set and collateral-preservation invariants will materially reduce silent destructive edits compared with complete-file regeneration plus a 50 percent shrink heuristic.
hypothesis.counterhypothesis: Supplying complete current source plus task-specific tests and the shrink heuristic already catches nearly all relevant damage, so the stricter contract mainly adds false rejects and latency.
hypothesis.falsifier: On a matched adversarial corpus of narrow existing-file edits, the simpler whole-file path has equal or lower false-accept collateral damage, rollback failure, and unintended-diff rate at comparable successful-task rate and cost.

current_trigger3_no_change_boundaries.root_mass_move: NO_CHANGE_WITH_REASON: current root inventory still blocks host/platform/canonical/unknown dependency moves; no cosmetic relocation performed

next_exact_gate: Implement or identify one canonical existing-file mutation path that satisfies EXACT_PREIMAGE_PATCH_INTEGRITY/v1, then independently execute its focused regressions on a clean current non-provider checkout before granting retained runtime credit.
